verdict_rationale: Smoke test (flag OFF) failed e2e p95 ±10% band of cycle-2d-n30's 4005 ms baseline. Smoke turns (n=3): 11518, 29544, 12021 ms. Root cause is PRE-EXISTING vLLM/Nemotron-Nano LLM degradation, NOT the cycle-2f patch. Direct vLLM probe with neutral system prompt produces JavaScript-like garbage. The same vLLM (pid 381330) generated clean dispatcher replies at 19:00-19:21Z during cycle-2d-n30 (e.g. 'Help is on the way. Stay on the line with me.', 'Lay him flat. Start compressions, two per second.'). State-shift between 19:21Z and 21:05Z (~2h interval). Patch wire-equivalence VERIFIED via worker log: 'worker.cycle2f_prosody_init cycle2f_prosody=disabled fillers_variant=plain'; smoke turn 1 rendered plain filler 'Okay, stay with me.' through Fish (would be '[soft] Stay with me.' if flag were ON). Per spec rails, smoke-fail triggers ROLLBACK + ABORT regardless of attribution. Files restored to canonical pre-cycle2f SHAs; worker restarted; flag drop-in (40-cycle2f.conf) was never created. Watchdog .pid mismatch is a stale-snapshot issue inherited from pre-state, not a cycle-2f regression.

summary_text: Cycle-2f voice-empathy/prosody-tag patch ROLLED BACK due to smoke-test failure. The cycle-2f patch (~25 LOC across worker.py + orchestrator.py, env-flag-gated default OFF) was applied successfully and verified wire-equivalent when PRISM42_ENABLE_TTS_PROSODY_TAGS=0 (worker log line 'worker.cycle2f_prosody_init cycle2f_prosody=disabled fillers_variant=plain' + smoke turn 1 rendered the plain filler 'Okay, stay with me.' through Fish, NOT the tagged variant). However, smoke e2e p95 fell outside the spec band (3604-4406 ms) at 11518/29544/12021 ms — a 7x baseline regression. Investigation revealed PRE-EXISTING vLLM/Nemotron-Nano LLM degradation: direct vLLM probe with a neutral system prompt produces JavaScript-like garbage; the same vLLM (pid 381330) was healthy at 19:00-19:21Z during cycle-2d-n30 (clean dispatcher replies in fish.log). Per spec rails 'smoke fail → ROLLBACK + ABORT', files were restored from .pre-cycle2f backups, worker restarted, watchdog re-run. Pre-rollback canonical SHAs preserved (worker f4053900..., orchestrator 9e96dad6...). The flag drop-in 40-cycle2f.conf was NEVER created because step 7 was blocked. All 4 services HTTP-healthy post-rollback. Bench (flag-ON 10 turns) skipped. Watchdog .pid mismatch is identical to pre-state (stale snapshot expects pid 285669, actual 381330). Empathy-tag subjective-character signal NOT measurable since neither the flag-OFF nor the (skipped) flag-ON bench produced clean LLM replies for grading. The patch itself is good and reusable — once vLLM is restored to baseline behavior, re-applying takes ~30s + a fresh smoke. The decision_rule_evaluation flow: STABLE_PASS_2F required smoke e2e p95 in [3604, 4406] ms (failed); patch wire-equivalence (passed); brackets-not-spoken (n/a, bench skipped); → ROLLBACK_2F enacted.
